summary: Validated both tasks: (1) footer city-strip removed, (2) /city/:slug renders using the homepage layout filtered to that city. All critical checks pass: no footer-cities / 'Cities we serve' heading on homepage or city pages; /city/patna and /city/ranchi show container data-testid='city-page' plus home-hero, home-trust, home-categories, 15 featured/trending service nodes, home-faq and home-blog. Hero eyebrow='Now serving Patna/Ranchi' and heading='Home services in Patna/Ranchi' render correctly. Main homepage still uses generic hero (container data-testid='home-page'), not pinned to a city. localStorage key 'azo_location' remains unchanged after visiting /city/patna in both empty and preset-Ranchi scenarios. /city/nowhere correctly renders data-testid='city-notfound'. Backend GET /api/site/homepage?city=Patna|Ranchi both return 200 and show matching categories to the UI (AC Repair & Service, Electrician, Home Cleaning, Plumbing, Appliance Repair, Carpentry, Maid Services). GET /api/site/city/patna 200, /nowhere 404. GET /api/seo/render?path=/city/patna returns 200 with <title>Home Services in Patna | AzoApp</title>. Service card click on /city/patna navigates to /service/<id> and detail page loads with Book Now button (booking entry intact).
